reviewItem.question: For "Loki now enforces a max line size of 256KB by default (you can disable this or increase this but this is how Grafana Labs runs Loki)", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether ingested log lines exceed 256KB and whether the max line size limit is explicitly configured

proposed.statement: Loki 3.0.0 now enforces a max log line size of 256KB by default; it can be disabled or raised.
